correctness.rationale: For inactive hub and r>=3, the rim response reduces to the indicator of zero active rim neighbors, hence the active rim is a maximal independent set with cyclic gaps 2 or 3. The number with k active vertices is M_m(k)=m/k*C(k,m−2k), 0 outside m/3<=k<=m/2; hub inactive forbids exactly k=r. Active hub gives all-inactive rim, plus all-active special case m=r=3. For r=2, rim equations over F2 are x_(i−1)+x_i+x_(i+1)=1−h, yielding x_(i+3)=x_i and 3-period classifications; hub conditions generate stated indicators. Unique equilibrium occurs precisely at m=7,r=3 after checking all possible independent set sizes. Perrin recurrence and dominant root yield asymptotics r fixed≥3; r=2 bounded. Independent exhaustive Nash action enumeration for every m=3..12 and r=2..m+2 agrees.
